purpose: Ingest and no-return screen one initial-report single-quarter gross-margin improvement mechanism for the fixed three-session A-share protocol without sweeping financial fields, revision choices, formulas, directions, event ages, dates, prices, or returns.

source_selection.why_this_source: The documented interface supplies announcement date, report period, an explicit single-quarter sales gross-margin field, and an initial-versus-revised flag. This permits one predeclared profitability-structure mechanism that is absent from the accepted quarterly ROE and growth gates.

mechanism_identity.economic_mechanism: A higher single-quarter sales gross margin than in the same fiscal quarter one year earlier represents newly disclosed pricing, product-mix, or input-cost power that may be incorporated over the next three sessions.
mechanism_identity.relationship_to_existing_quarterly_quali: ROE, positive net profit, revenue YoY, profit YoY, report age, and their already audited accelerations remain fixed context or eligibility fields. The candidate measures the percentage-point change in gross margin before operating expenses and must pass explicit no-return synonym checks against all six quarterly level and acceleration fields.
mechanism_identity.relationship_to_other_terminal_mechanism: It is not price momentum, valuation, dividend yield, cash conversion, audit reliability, forecast magnitude, disclosure timing, ownership, analyst activity, transaction events, industry breadth, or order flow.

source.request_mode: one frozen stock and report-period range per call

point_in_time_and_version_policy.documented_revision_semantics: Tushare states that update_flag=0 is initial financial data and update_flag=1 is revised financial data.
point_in_time_and_version_policy.initial_row_policy: Only complete update_flag=0 rows may supply q_gsprofit_margin, ann_date, or either side of the year-over-year formula.
point_in_time_and_version_policy.revised_row_policy: Complete update_flag=1 rows are counted as revision context but never selected, ranked, substituted, or used to repair a missing initial row.
point_in_time_and_version_policy.initial_duplicate_policy: Exact five-field duplicates may be counted and collapsed. More than one distinct initial ann_date or q_gsprofit_margin tuple for one stock and report period makes that period version-ambiguous and excludes it.
point_in_time_and_version_policy.revised_conflict_policy: Differing revised rows do not change the frozen initial factor; they are counted without persisting their values.
point_in_time_and_version_policy.date_policy: ann_date and end_date must be complete valid dates, end_date must be a standard quarter end, and end_date must not be later than ann_date.
point_in_time_and_version_policy.year_over_year_pair: Match only the same stock and the exact same fiscal quarter end shifted back one calendar year; never use the immediately previous quarter, an annualized value, TTM value, interpolation, or a different provider.
point_in_time_and_version_policy.current_event_date: the initial ann_date of the current report period
point_in_time_and_version_policy.prior_year_availability_check: the prior-year initial ann_date must be strictly earlier than the current initial ann_date
point_in_time_and_version_policy.conservative_availability: first local trading session strictly after the current initial ann_date
point_in_time_and_version_policy.residual_risk: The initial-versus-revised flag and strict next-session rule reduce look-ahead risk, but the standard endpoint is a current vendor snapshot and does not provide a complete historical revision timestamp stream. Missing initial rows are therefore excluded rather than reconstructed.

factor.name: tushare_single_quarter_gross_margin_yoy_change
factor.finite_value_policy: both margins and the derived difference must be finite
factor.range_policy: No economic clipping threshold is applied at source acceptance; observed extrema are reported and any nonfinite result is excluded and counted.

required_checks_before_full_sync: the environment supplies TUSHARE_TOKEN without logging its value
exactly one fina_indicator request is issued for each frozen stock and report-period range with only the frozen five fields
each response has at least twenty rows and strictly fewer than the documented one-hundred-row ceiling
the response contains exactly the requested fields; keys are complete; every stock matches its request; dates are valid and report periods are standard quarter ends
update_flag is exactly zero or one; only zero rows enter the factor and one rows are count-only revision context
exact five-field duplicates alone may collapse; conflicting initial tuples exclude their period and are counted
both margins in a year-over-year pair come from initial rows for the same issuer and fiscal quarter and the prior initial announcement precedes the current one
each frozen stock retains at least eighteen initial quarters and twelve finite derived year-over-year events
the combined acceptance sample has at least six distinct derived values
no credential, forbidden financial field, revised value, price, market cap, turnover, score, or return appears in a published factor frame or manifest
acceptance_protocol.failed_acceptance_policy: write one no-return rejection record and stop without another stock, field relaxation, revised-row substitution, full sync, capacity, uniqueness, price access, formula or direction change, score, selection, sizing, orders, or Level-2 justification
acceptance_protocol.one_shot_policy: The exact contract may publish at most one terminal success or rejection record.

full_snapshot_contract.provider_call_partition: two frozen report-period slices per source-universe stock: 20180101-20211231 and 20220101-20251231
full_snapshot_contract.partition_policy: one announcement calendar year per immutable Parquet partition
full_snapshot_contract.failure_cleanup: delete the complete temporary snapshot and publish no final manifest

source_completeness_policy.coverage_denominator: factor_main_chinext_star instruments active at each standard report period and present in the frozen source universe
source_completeness_policy.failed_gate_policy: stop before event expansion, capacity, uniqueness, or returns; do not use revised rows, lower coverage thresholds, omit weak periods, mix providers, request another financial field, or alter the formula

no_return_capacity_policy.quality_gate: ROE >= 5%, positive net profit, positive revenue YoY, and positive profit YoY, effective only after the next local session following announcement
no_return_capacity_policy.failed_gate_policy: stop without reading returns, using revised values, changing direction or age, lowering capacity, selecting fiscal quarters, or combining a rejected factor

no_return_uniqueness_policy.comparison_scope: every factor in the frozen 43-factor accepted-price frontier plus every later mechanism with a defined same-session value
no_return_uniqueness_policy.method: On factor-active sessions, rank the frozen gross-margin change as higher-is-better inside the same quality/listing-eligible cross-section; compare Spearman ranks with every eligible comparison field and take each comparison's median daily correlation.
no_return_uniqueness_policy.failed_gate_policy: terminally classify the candidate as a near synonym before any return access; do not residualize, neutralize, invert, reweight, combine, or choose another gross-margin field
